svg.title: Home wireframe comparison and annotations
svg.desc: Grayscale structural wireframe. No final artwork. Progressed figures are illustrative. Dashed top and bottom lines mark the safe area.

g.text: A small stall. A growing shop.
Layout review only · Grayscale placeholders · 1080 × 1920 reference
TAP TO EARN · THEN OPEN PRODUCTS
Phuljhari · ₹120 to stock your first shelf
No new currencies or account UI.
Only this scene surface earns taps.
Normal income stays clear in boosts.
Disabled while the boost is active.
Tap selected tab again for Home.
Controls: minimum 48 × 48 logical pixels. At 360 wide, 144 reference pixels = 48 logical pixels.
Dashed top and bottom boundaries mark safe insets. Navigation has a padded 144 px touch area.
Short screens compress scene space; the income summary, skills and navigation remain visible.
Buttons, overlays and drag gestures never award tap income. Home has no scrolling.
Wireframe → your review → reference image → HTML → Unity
No game files changed. Later screens will be designed individually after Home review.
